text:
anna: Hey team — planning the users.email_address migration for tomorrow. Need an owner for deploy + smoke validation. Proposed window: 2025-06-04 02:00-03:00 UTC. Who can own the deploy?
devin: I can run the deploy and backfill. prefer +15m buffer on either side.
mike: I can do smoke checks and watch tracing/dashboards. Will be on-call that window.
priya: I'll coordinate rollback readiness and DB replicas. Sharing the minimal rollback plan below.
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance tag will be auto-applied at 2025-06-04T02:00:00Z to affected services.
anna: Thanks. Quick checklist so we don't miss anything: 1) Pre-migration schema feature flag on. 2) Start dual-write for 30m. 3) Backfill small shard first. 4) Run smoke suite. 5) Monitor error budget.
devin: Agreed. I propose starting dual-write at 02:05, backfill shard-1 at 02:10, after shard-1 green then ramp other shards. If anything >5% error or 500s spikes we abort and rollback.
mike: Smoke tests I'll run: 
```
# smoke commands
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.test/users?email=smoke@example.com | jq .id
# basic flow: create user, update email, lookup by email
```
I will post results in this thread.
priya: Rollback plan: 
- Disable dual-write (flip feature flag) -> writes go to old schema only.
- Cancel ongoing backfills.
- If schema changes are destructive, restore replica from pre-migration snapshot (we have a 30m snapshot window).
Rollback criteria: sustained >5% user-facing errors for 10m OR replication lag >30s for >5m.
anna: Who will own communication to customer-success if we need rollback?
devin: I can notify CS and update status page.
mike: I'll keep an eye on latency traces (APM) and infra metrics in Console.
priya: Can someone run a dry-run today in staging? Need timings for backfill per shard.
devin: I'll do staging dry-run at 16:00 PT today and post timing numbers.
anna: Great. Also add a quick smoke script to run after each shard backfill (devin/mike to coordinate).
mike: Will add script to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/migrations#email-migration and point to smoke logs.
priya: Ops checklist before taking traffic: 
- Confirm replica lag < 1s
- Confirm backups completed <1h old
- Confirm SLO alert thresholds muted for the window if owned by us
- Dev deploy + migration config applied
- Pager rotations: mike (monitor), anna (backup), devin (deploy)
anna: tagging @devin @mike @priya for ownership. If no objections by EOD I'll mark this as booked.
devin: no objections. booking confirmed.
ops-bot: Booking confirmed: users.email_address migration on 2025-06-04T02:00Z. Assigned: devin (deploy), mike (monitor), priya (rollback).
